user.title: CUR Gás Natural Setup
user.description: Sign in with your CUR Gás Natural customer portal account (portal.curgasnatural.pt). Data is refreshed twice a day (02:00 and 14:00).

contract.title: Choose a contract
contract.description: Your account holds more than one contract. Pick the delivery point this entry should track — add the integration again for the others.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate CUR Gás Natural
reauth_confirm.description: The stored password for {email} no longer works. Enter the current portal password to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach the CUR Gás Natural portal

abort.no_contracts: This account has no contracts to track
abort.unknown_contract: That contract is no longer available

init.title: Volume to energy conversion
init.description: The meter counts m³ but your supplier bills kWh, using the network's conversion factor printed on every invoice next to the reading (e.g. "4 m³ x 11.20808 = 45 kWh"). Set it here so the energy sensors and the Gas dashboard's cost match your invoice.
